cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Yes, I'll help you move the sofa. I'll take the cushions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're sewn on. We have to lift together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Absolutely. You lift; I'll say when. Together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need another person underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll book someone on your phone. Then I can give both of you the same countdown.

mechanism: A agrees to help lift furniture but uses corrective moving expertise to redefine every agreement as A supervising while other people supply effort.
confusable: Simple refusal would say no; A must sincerely say yes and then interpret the promised help to A advantage.
comparison: Dog alternative transfers care back to the owner under expert organisation; sofa scene recruits labour while A keeps the directing role.
seedUse: Sewn cushions, simultaneous lift and second carrier derive from D23-a; S03 adds sequencing and grip corrections that justify A supervisory interpretation.
